device.description: V4L2 camera device path used for capture (e.g. /dev/video0).

fps.description: Camera capture frame rate in frames per second.

model_input_width.description: Width the frame is resized to before inference; should match the model input width.

model_input_height.description: Height the frame is resized to before inference; should match the model input height.

queue_size.description: Maximum number of frames held in the inference queue.

async_inference.description: Run inference asynchronously (non-blocking) instead of synchronously.
